essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer three (3) questions in this section. Write your answers clearly and draw well-labelled diagrams where required.

questions.question:
(a) Name four similarities found in plant and animal cells. (4 marks)
(b) Draw and fully label an 8–10cm diagram of a typical animal cell. (6 marks)

(a) (i) What is a cell? (2 marks)
(ii) Make a labelled diagram, 8–10cm long, of Euglena. (5 marks)
(b) (i) List three animal-like features of Euglena. (2 marks)
(ii) State two plant-like features of Euglena. (1 mark)

(a) (i) In a tabular form, state four differences between a plant cell and an animal cell. (4 marks)
(ii) State four similarities between a plant cell and an animal cell. (2 marks)
(b) Identify four classes of organisms found in Phylum Vertebrata.

(a) (i) Name the four levels of organization in living organisms. (4 marks)
(ii) Explain two of the levels of organization mentioned in (a)(i). (2 marks)
(b) State the level of organization of each of the following:
(i) Euglena
(ii) Onion bulb
(iii) Blood
(iv) Hydra. (4 marks)
